description: Exercise representation negotiation across additional branches: requesting a representation the controller does not declare, and requesting a supported script representation for a delete write. When the requested representation is not among those the controller declares, the request fails and the error is reported as a neutral category rather than leaking any runtime detail. When a script representation is requested and supported for a write, the action's script view is rendered instead of redirecting while the conventional flash is still set.

cases.expected_output:
store=find id=42
store=destroy ok=true
assign=article
status=200
body=Destroy JS
flash.notice=Article was successfully destroyed.
